caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with a slant-front surface, commonly known as a secretary desk. The desk is rendered in shades of brown that simulate the natural color and grain of wood. It has four slender, gently curved legs. The front section of the desk features a large drop-front panel that covers the interior writing space, decorated with a central keyhole and a gold-colored ornamental design. Below the drop-front panel is a wide drawer, also adorned with gold-colored handles and an ornate central design on each side. The top surface of the desk is bordered at the back with a small gold-colored railing or gallery. The background is a plain light beige color with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Desk (Lady's)
